import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p04-csv-pm25-ranking/air_quality_hourly.csv')

# Calculate mean PM2.5 per station, ignoring NaN values
station_means = df.groupby('station')['pm25_ugm3'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("Mean PM2.5 per station:")
print(station_means)
print("\nTop 3 stations:")
top3 = station_means.head(3)
print(top3)
print("\nStation names (highest mean first):")
print(', '.join(top3.index.tolist()))
